Wingspire Equipment Finance, an equipment-financing arm of Wingspire Capital, a portfolio company of Blue Owl Capital
, closed a $407.07M asset-backed securitization (ABS), its largest to date.
The deal was more than 5x oversubscribed, with senior notes receiving AAA ratings from Fitch Ratings and Kroll Bond Rating Agency.
The financing is backed by $438.18M of equipment lease and loan contracts as of Aug. 31, 2026.
The latest issuance is up from $201M in 2024 and $292M+ in 2025, marking the company’s third consecutive increase in ABS volume.
The company funded $701.3M in 2025, up 66% YoY, as it expands equipment financing for middle-market and private equity-backed companies.

title: Blue Owl-linked Wingspire closes $407M ABS with 5x demand
